milestones.label: Application deadline (course funding deadline, December 2026 or January 2027 depending on the course)
milestones.source_text: There is no separate Clarendon form; Oxford applicants are considered if they apply by the funding deadline of their course. One Oxford department (Social Policy and Intervention) states noon UK time on 7 January 2027 for its courses; a scholarship site reports the range is December 2026 or January 2027 (unofficial).
